notes_for_human: Three caveats. (1) Cubist QD email instruction: the BuiltIn NYC mirror carries the sentence verbatim but the fetch tool masked the address as [email protected]; the full address KEPL-talent@cubistsystematic.com with subject '2027 QD Summer Internship Application' appeared in Google-indexed copies of the same posting text (including the careers.point72.com posting). Treat the address as tier-3-corroborated, not tier-1-verified; the tier-1 page itself was unreadable. (2) Cubist QD posting states a degree-field requirement ('Undergraduate degree or higher in math, computer science, or other quantitative fields') but no explicit graduation-year window — so class-year in the strict sense is not stated. It also says Point72 'will consider full-time offers for interns after the internship' per search-indexed posting text (unverified verbatim). (3) Academy 2027 US: search-indexed posting text says candidates 'must be current students who will graduate from university between December 2027 and July 2028', salary '$120,000 - $140,000 (USD)' prorated, rolling with no set deadline, and one application globally per cycle — all consistent across indexed copies but unverified verbatim because the tier-1 page is JS-blocked. No published cooling-off/reapplication rule was found anywhere on Point72 domains. Tool-call budget reached; re-run with a headless browser against careers.point72.com to convert the 'unverified' Academy fields to tier-1 verbatim. UPDATE 2026-07-29 browser session: the Academy one-application-globally rule is now tier-1 verified verbatim on the live US posting (CPA-0014871).
